title: Sunspot Watch
text:
☀️ Sunspot Watch — October 15, 2026

Sunny is taking a closer look at NOAA Active Region 4551, where a particularly prominent sunspot group is showing up on the solar disk.

📍 Location: S15W05
☀️ Region: AR 4551
🔥 Recent activity: 1 C-class flare

Spotted. Literally.

Sunspots are cooler, magnetically active regions of the solar surface and are often associated with solar flares and other activity.

Image: N/A
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center + NASA SDO
